protocol.model: f=max(b,2)*exp(origin effect+destination effect),Gaussian log-effect prior;countGaussian or Huber
protocol.scope: Low-dimensional positive demand-factor MAP,not old additive Gaussian covariance or alternative path choice
protocol.optimization: Two starts,bounds+-3,L-BFGS-B plus exact-Hessian/roundoff-budget polish;unchanged projected-gradient<=2e-4,local only

numerical_repair_reference.policy: Same grid/data/seeds/objective/tolerance;retain original sealed selection;assessment is numerical regression

protocol.selection: One setting max worst-regime dev gain then mean;accept only mean>=.005 and worst>=-.002 and all successful
protocol.assessment: Generate only after choice seal;evaluate ridge,entropy,selected deployment policy and fixed dev hypothesis
protocol.truth: Own forward/reverse known-truth generators,public network/weakprior only;no reference or hidden path truth

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights
